newsitem.title: GERMANY: HMR to launch diabetes drug in Germany.
newsitem.headline: HMR to launch diabetes drug in Germany.

text.p: Hoechst Marion Roussel (HMR), the pharmaceutical wing of Hoechst AG, said on Friday it would introduce a new diabetes drug on the German market on November 25.
In a statement, HMR said the drug had been approved for sale in Germany by the federal institute for medications and medical products on October 18. Its brand name is Amaryl.
The drug has been on sale in the U.S., Switzerland, Denmark, Sweden, Argentina and the Netherlands since earlier this year and will soon be launched in other countries.
The oral drug can be used to treat type II diabetes. A single daily dose is sufficient to keep the blood sugar level under control, HMR said.
It said the drug had the advantage of carrying a relatively low risk of the blood sugar level being pushed too low and also carried fewer risks of delayed harm.
